experiences.name: Prague Castle Complex Tour
experiences.description: Explore the largest ancient castle complex in the world, including St. Vitus Cathedral, the Old Royal Palace, and Golden Lane. Walk through centuries of Bohemian history with stunning panoramic views over Prague's red-rooftop skyline.

experiences.name: Budapest Thermal Bath Experience at Széchenyi
experiences.description: Soak in one of Europe's largest and most iconic thermal bath complexes, built in 1913 in stunning Neo-Baroque style. Enjoy indoor and outdoor pools fed by natural hot springs, a beloved Budapest tradition blending wellness with cultural heritage.

experiences.name: Danube River Evening Cruise
experiences.description: Sail along the Danube at dusk to witness Budapest's illuminated skyline, including the Hungarian Parliament Building, Buda Castle, and Chain Bridge. A breathtaking way to absorb the city's architectural grandeur and romantic atmosphere.

experiences.name: Prague Old Town & Astronomical Clock Walking Tour
experiences.description: Join a guided walking tour through Prague's UNESCO-listed Old Town Square, witnessing the medieval Astronomical Clock strike the hour, exploring Týn Church, and uncovering stories of Bohemian kings, plagues, and revolutions.

experiences.name: Budapest Ruin Bar Crawl & Hungarian Street Food Tour
experiences.description: Discover Budapest's legendary ruin bars born from abandoned Jewish Quarter buildings, while sampling traditional Hungarian street food including lángos (fried dough), kürtőskalács (chimney cake), and local craft beers. A perfect blend of history, culture, and nightlife.
